subject: Request: approval for SprintBridge makewhole / credit proposal
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@sprintbridge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@sprintbridge.com, S. Jenkins <s.jenkins@sprintbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: November outage & request for account remedy

Mina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. To recap from our side: last Tuesday (11/17) we saw a 27% spike in LLM latency across our production endpoints during the 10:30–11:45am PST window. That impacted two customer-facing features (recommendation generation + search rerank). Our ops team spent the afternoon rolling throttles and routing to fallback models; incident timeline attached.

SprintBridge is asking for a remedial package given the customer impact. High-level ask from my leadership: either (A) a service credit equivalent to 1.5 months of typical monthly spend for Nov (we're estimating ~$110k) or (B) a blended option: 30% off November invoice + a $30k credit applied to Q1 2027 usage. We understand the contract SLOs and are open to your suggested alternatives.

Can you confirm what your recommended makewhole is and whether you can get an exec sign-off for anything beyond standard policy? We are on a tight renewal cadence and hope to close this amicably.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Senior Product Ops, SprintBridge

[Attachment: SLA-incident-timeline.pdf (PDF)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@sprintbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: November outage & request for account remedy

Alex —

Thank you for the clear summary and the timeline. I'm really sorry SprintBridge saw that impact; we know how visible that kind of latency is for your product. I pulled our usage report and initial analysis (attached). A couple of quick notes for transparency:

- The window you noted coincides with an autoscaling anomaly where our KV cache thrash combined with a spike in long-sequence generations.
- We have a draft remediation and kernel tuning plan that we can apply to your Dedicated pool to prevent recurrence; that'll reduce tail latency risk.

Proposal options (internal recommendation):
1) Standard policy: service credit per SLA: 10% pro-rated for the impacted period (~$28k).
2) Customer-success option (requires manager approval): 45% credit on November overage buckets + two weeks of free burst capacity for December (value ~ $65k).
3) Executive makewhole (requires exec approval): one full month credit + prioritized on-site performance tuning engagement (value ~ $110k–$130k).

I don't yet have authority to approve #3; I'm looping Marissa and Jonas to request exec dispensation. If you and your CFO prefer a blended option (option 2 + $30k credit applied to Q1 usage), we can try to structure that and expedite approvals.

Next step: Alex — are you ok with the blended option to keep momentum? Marissa/Jonas — can you weigh in on the authorization path?

Best,
Mina
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: usage-report-nov.csv (CSV)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up: November outage & request for account remedy

Mina —

Thanks for the clear framing. I agree with the blended ask as the path of least resistance to retain the renewal. A couple operational notes for approval:

- SprintBridge annual committed spend (booked) is ~$1.2M with 18-month term remaining.
- Our delegated credit authority at AE/AM level tops out at $25k; manager signoff needed above that and exec above $75k.

I support authorizing option 2 + $30k applied to Q1 (total ~ $95k). That exceeds my individual approval so I'm requesting Marissa's sign-off for exec-level concession. We should ask for a 1:1 renewal extension incentive (add two months free if they commit to a 12-month extension) — that will protect our revenue.

Marissa — can you approve up to $100k one-off credit for retention, and if so I'll draft the CC and DocuSign amendment for procure. Want to move fast — they indicated they may pause negotiations if we delay.

Jonas
VP, Sales Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: November outage & request for account remedy

Jonas / Mina —

I can approve up to $100k one-off credit for retention if we secure the renewal commitment and include the prioritized perf engagement. Approve with the following gating items:
1) Formal amendment signed (DocuSign) that documents the credit application and the 12-month extension clause.
2) Technical remediation playbook and timeline delivered within 10 business days with measurable SLO targets.
3) Clear rollback plan for any future tiered credits — cap total concessions at 2 months equivalent over the term.

If those items are accepted by SprintBridge, Mina/Jonas proceed. Otherwise, escalate to MarCom/legal for a narrower settlement.

Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@sprintbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, procure@sprintbridge.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:44:00 -0800
Subject: Final: proposed settlement & next steps (DocuSign link)

Alex —

Thanks for your patience. Per Marissa's approval path above, Redwood will offer the blended package:
- One-time credit: 30% off November overage buckets + $30,000 credit applied to Q1 2027 usage (combined estimated value ~$95k).
- Prioritized performance tuning engagement (two weeks remote + one onsite day) to be scheduled in Dec/Jan.
- Contingency: credit only applied once the signed DocuSign amendment is returned and the renewal commitment (12 months) is executed.

I've created the amendment and routed via DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.com/ro/sprintbridge-makeup-credit-20261124
Please review and sign so we can schedule the tuning work. Procurement — let us know if you need any changes on the SOW or counters to the amendment.

Best,
Mina
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: proposed-makeup-credit-schedule.xlsx (XLSX)]
